hero.subtitle: الكثير من الخيارات لا جهد

origin.title: لماذا بدأنا
paragraphs: SIPP is a local delivery platform built for one simple reason: to make ordering food, groceries, and essentials effortless — in places where traditional delivery never really worked.

We started in Santa Teresa, Costa Rica, where tourists, locals, villas, and restaurants all face the same problem: great food, great places — but fragmented, unreliable, and outdated delivery systems.
SIPP changes that.

We connect restaurants, grocery suppliers, and local businesses into one intelligent platform that allows customers to order everything they need in one place — from meals and snacks to drinks, groceries, and daily essentials — with fast, organized, and trackable delivery.

different.title: ماذا؟ SIPP مختلفة
different.intro: SIPP ليس فقط تطبيق توصيل الطعام It is a local commerce and logistical platform designed specifically for coastal and high-tourism regions.
items: A wide selection of restaurants and local partners
Grocery and essentials delivery alongside prepared food
Strong support for restaurants and partners
different.outro: بدلاً من إجبار نماذج الإيصال العالمية على الأسواق الصغيرة، بنينا SIPP حول كيفية عمل هذه المدن فعلاً - الموسمية، الذروة السياحية، الموردين المحليين، ولوجستيات المساعدة القصيرة.
different.result: والنتيجة هي منبر يعود بالفائدة على الجميع: فالزبائن يحصلون على الملاءمة والتنوع، والمطاعم تحصل على مزيد من الأوامر والوضوح، وتحصل المجتمعات المحلية على الهياكل الأساسية الحديثة للإيصال.

local.title: بني محلياً مصممة للحجم
paragraphs: SIPP was founded and is operated in Costa Rica. Our team works on the ground with restaurants, couriers, supermarkets, and villas every day.
That local presence allows us to control quality, delivery times, onboarding, and customer experience — while continuously improving the platform.
At the same time, SIPP is built with scale in mind. Our technology, logistics model, and partner structure are designed to expand across coastal regions, tourism hubs, and emerging delivery markets.

mission.title: مهمتنا
mission.statement: أن يصبح برنامج التسليم الرئيسي والتجارة المحلية عبر المناطق الساحلية في كوستاريكا ولاعب إقليمي طويل الأجل في أسواق السياحة العالية.
paragraphs: We are building more than an app.
We are building the system that powers everyday life: food, groceries, restaurants, and local businesses — all in one place.

hero.title: كيف يعمل؟
hero.subtitle: SIPP هو منصة توصيل على الإنترنت التي تجلب البقع المفضلة لبلدتك مباشرة إلى عتبة بابك. نحن نربط الزبائن بالأعمال التجارية المحلية - المطاعم، المقاهي، القضبان، متاجر البقالة - ونتعامل مع التوصيل من خلال طاقمنا اللوجستي

steps.title: هكذا SIPP يعمل في أربع خطوات سهلة

items.title: 1. Browse & Order
items.description: Pop into our platform from any device (phone, tablet, or computer) and see what tickles your fancy. Browse by category or search for a specific restaurant, store, dish or product. Sign in, add items to your cart and place your order with a few clicks. You can pay securely with your credit card – easy, fast, and cash-free.

items.title: 2. We Confirm & Prep
items.description: The moment you order, we automatically send the request over to the chosen restaurant or shop. They'll give it a thumbs up and start prepping your items with love and care. Whether it's a hot meal being cooked or groceries being packed, we keep things moving quickly. That's when your order status will change from Pending, to Accepted and then, to Preparing.

items.title: 3. Out for Delivery
items.description: As soon as your order is ready to roll, one of our SIPP couriers springs into action. They'll pick up your order and head straight to your location. You can track your delivery in real time on our platform. Feel free to do a little happy dance; your goods are on the way!

items.title: 4. Delivered & Enjoy
items.description: Ding-dong! Delivery has arrived. Our courier will hand off your order at your door. Now all that's left is to dig in and enjoy.

deliveryArea.title: أين نسلّم؟
paragraphs: Currently, SIPP operates in and around Santa Teresa, Costa Rica, covering the nearby locations – from Manzanillo to Santiago, Playa Hermosa, Playa Carmen, and Mal País. We're a local service, so we know these roads like the back of our hand (yes, that shortcut past the surf shop? We know it). Good news: we're expanding soon! SIPP will be coming to Nosara next, so stay tuned.

closing.body: باختصار SIPP يعمل تماما مثل تلك التطبيقات التسليمية الكبيرة - ولكن مع زيادة Pura Vida flair. ونحن نفخر بأن نكون سريعين وموثوقين ورائعين قليلا (إذا قلنا ذلك بأنفسنا). جائع؟ عطشان؟ خارج معجون الأسنان؟ كل ما تحتاجه SIPP هو.
